title: Risk Management Regulation: Lost, Stolen and Recovered Instruments of the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program
content:
## Regulation

(a) Only the family reports an instrument lost or stolen; the support desk records the report and the family confirms it.

(b) A lost instrument is charged the replacement charge of the usage type, and a lost case the case replacement charge.

(c) A stolen instrument is charged the stolen-with-report charge instead when a police report number is given within the theft report window of calendar days after the theft, the theft date being day 0; otherwise it is charged as lost.

(d) An instrument found and turned in within the same school year credits its replacement charge in full as an instrument found credit, less any late fee and repair charge it then incurs.

These provisions apply to district-owned instruments and cases loaned under the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program.

## Commentary on the provisions

**On (a).** The report of a loss or theft comes from the family. The report records the date it was made and, for a theft, the police report number exactly as the family gives it.

**On (c), the window.** The theft date is day 0. A police report number given on any day up to and including the last day of the window is within it; a number given after the last day, or never given, is not, and the stolen instrument is then charged as a lost instrument at the replacement charge.

**On (d), the credit.** The credit is the replacement charge less any late fee and any repair charge the instrument incurs when it is turned in.

## Decision table for a stolen instrument

| Police report number given | Given within the window (theft date day 0) | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the stolen-with-report charge |
| yes | no | the replacement charge, as lost |
| no | not applicable | the replacement charge, as lost |

## Worked examples on hypothetical figures

The amounts are hypothetical, chosen only to show the provisions; the program's own charges are those of its replacement schedule. Hypothetical replacement charge 900.00, stolen-with-report charge 120.00, case replacement charge 70.00, report window 5 days.

1. A family reports an instrument and its case lost. The charges are 900.00 for the instrument and 70.00 for the case.
2. A family reports an instrument stolen and gives the police report number on day 3 after the theft. The charge is 120.00.
3. The same theft, with the number given on day 7. The number is outside the window, and the charge is 900.00, as lost.
4. An instrument charged 900.00 as lost is found and turned in later in the same school year. On its return it incurs a hypothetical late fee of 20.00 and a hypothetical repair charge of 60.00. The instrument found credit is 900.00 less 20.00 less 60.00, that is 820.00.
